fields.description:
T15 standing eval fixture implementation plan.

## Work
- Add src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/plan-review-T15.eval.yaml using the packaged eval schema and registered deterministic scorers.
- Cover an applicable/pass deployed service that names runtime-only boot, authentication, authorization, connectivity, and readiness risks; uses a concrete local or real-target manual proof before codification; and cleans only experiment-created artifacts.
- Cover applicable/findings where the only feedback is the full slow delivery loop, and where cleanup drops a pre-existing table or wipes a shared bucket.
- Cover not-applicable/pass plans for app-only, library-only, CLI-only, docs-only, health-route, and incidental deploy wording; plus S2 fast/cheap-pipeline and S3 unit-test-settled boundaries.
- Register the packaged spec in the shared strict-clean and balanced eval contract tests; add T15-specific assertions that pin its labeled case matrix.
- Record the application-scope negatives in docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/eval/observed-false-positives.md.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The command .venv/bin/rebar prompt eval plan-review-T15 validates the packaged spec offline with strict-clean schema, registered deterministic scorers, a balanced pass/finding dataset, and a non-empty gold set.
- [ ] The dataset has an applicable/pass deployed-service case naming boot, authentication, authorization, connectivity, and readiness risks plus a concrete fast out-of-loop proof before codification and cleanup limited to experiment-created artifacts.
- [ ] The dataset has an applicable/finding deployed-service case whose only feedback is the full slow delivery loop.
- [ ] The dataset has applicable/finding destructive-cleanup cases for dropping a pre-existing table and wiping a shared bucket.
- [ ] The dataset has not-applicable/pass cases for app-only, library-only, CLI-only, docs-only, health-route, and incidental deploy application-code plans.
- [ ] The dataset has not-applicable/pass S2 and S3 boundary cases for a fast/cheap pipeline and correctness settled by unit tests.
- [ ] Unit tests pin the expected T15 case identifiers, labels, scorer discipline, and packaged-spec validation through the public eval loader.
- [ ] observed-false-positives.md records the T15 application-scope negatives as regression guards.

## Testing
- Run .venv/bin/rebar prompt eval plan-review-T15 through the supported offline command.
- Run .venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/test_new_eval_specs.py tests/unit/test_t15_overlay_derisk_criterion.py -q for packaged loading, scorer registration, balance, gold coverage, and the T15 case matrix.
- Run make lint, make typecheck, and make test with the worktree virtualenv first on PATH.
- Live semantic evaluation remains opt-in and nondeterministic per README.plan-review.md; deterministic offline discipline and the labeled standing corpus are the CI gate.
